subject: Next steps after the demo
opener: Thanks for the time on the demo. Here is what I took away, and what we said we would do next.

bullets.text: The demo landed. After-hours routing, answering machine detection and consent-tracked texting all resonated with you.
You said downtime is a dealbreaker, that you cannot be down during patient hours at all.
I will send the SOC 2 report and the TCPA one-pager to your office manager, both by Friday.
You will pull the RingHawk call-volume report and send it over, early next week, so I can size the deal.
Once those documents are exchanged, we both move to pricing.

close: Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.
